$comment: CQL (Cassandra 5 / ScyllaDB) built-in functions (plan-batch3 WP-CS); same shape as sqlite-functions.json.

functions.name: now
functions.doc: A new unique timeuuid for the current time, generated on the coordinator. Every call returns a different value, so `WHERE t = now()` never matches.

functions.name: uuid
functions.doc: A new random (version 4) uuid.

functions.name: current_timestamp
functions.doc: The current time as a timestamp (coordinator clock). Cassandra 5.0 name; currentTimestamp() on 4.x and earlier.

functions.name: currentTimestamp
functions.doc: The current time as a timestamp (coordinator clock). (Pre-5.0 name of current_timestamp(), still accepted.)

functions.name: current_date
functions.doc: The current date (coordinator clock, UTC). Cassandra 5.0 name; currentDate() on 4.x and earlier.

functions.name: currentDate

functions.name: current_time
functions.doc: The current time of day (coordinator clock, UTC). Cassandra 5.0 name; currentTime() on 4.x and earlier.

functions.name: currentTime
functions.doc: The current time of day (coordinator clock, UTC). (Pre-5.0 name of current_time(), still accepted.)

functions.name: current_timeuuid
functions.doc: A new timeuuid for the current time (same as now()). Cassandra 5.0 name; currentTimeUUID() on 4.x and earlier.

functions.name: currentTimeUUID
functions.doc: A new timeuuid for the current time (same as now()). (Pre-5.0 name of current_timeuuid(), still accepted.)

functions.name: to_date
functions.doc: Converts a timeuuid or timestamp to a date. Cassandra 5.0 name; toDate() on 4.x and earlier.

functions.name: toDate
functions.doc: Converts a timeuuid or timestamp to a date. (Pre-5.0 name of to_date(), still accepted.)

functions.name: to_timestamp
functions.doc: Converts a timeuuid or date to a timestamp (a date becomes midnight UTC). Cassandra 5.0 name; toTimestamp() on 4.x and earlier.

functions.name: toTimestamp
functions.doc: Converts a timeuuid or date to a timestamp (a date becomes midnight UTC). (Pre-5.0 name of to_timestamp(), still accepted.)

functions.name: to_unix_timestamp
functions.doc: Milliseconds since the Unix epoch of a timeuuid, timestamp or date. Cassandra 5.0 name; toUnixTimestamp() on 4.x and earlier.

functions.name: toUnixTimestamp
functions.doc: Milliseconds since the Unix epoch of a timeuuid, timestamp or date. (Pre-5.0 name of to_unix_timestamp(), still accepted.)

functions.name: min_timeuuid
functions.doc: The smallest timeuuid of the given time: the lower bound of a timeuuid range query (`t > min_timeuuid('2026-01-01')`). Not unique: never insert it. Cassandra 5.0 name; minTimeuuid() on 4.x and earlier.

functions.name: minTimeuuid
functions.doc: The smallest timeuuid of the given time: the lower bound of a timeuuid range query (`t > min_timeuuid('2026-01-01')`). Not unique: never insert it. (Pre-5.0 name of min_timeuuid(), still accepted.)

functions.name: max_timeuuid
functions.doc: The largest timeuuid of the given time: the upper bound of a timeuuid range query. Not unique: never insert it. Cassandra 5.0 name; maxTimeuuid() on 4.x and earlier.

functions.name: maxTimeuuid
functions.doc: The largest timeuuid of the given time: the upper bound of a timeuuid range query. Not unique: never insert it. (Pre-5.0 name of max_timeuuid(), still accepted.)

functions.name: dateOf
functions.doc: Timestamp of a timeuuid. Deprecated since Cassandra 2.2 and removed in 5.0: use to_timestamp().

functions.name: unixTimestampOf
functions.doc: Milliseconds since the epoch of a timeuuid. Deprecated since Cassandra 2.2 and removed in 5.0: use to_unix_timestamp().

functions.name: token
functions.doc: The partitioner token of the partition key (all partition key columns, in order). Used for paging through a table by token range: `WHERE token(id) > token(42)`. A bigint for Murmur3Partitioner.

functions.name: ttl
functions.doc: Remaining time to live of the cell in seconds, or null when it has none. Not allowed on primary key columns or counters; a collection column gives one value per element (Cassandra 5).

functions.name: writetime
functions.doc: Write timestamp of the cell (microseconds since the epoch). Not allowed on primary key columns or counters; a non-frozen collection gives one value per element (Cassandra 5).

functions.name: maxwritetime
functions.doc: Cassandra 5: the largest write timestamp among the cells of a (multi-cell) column.

functions.name: mask_inner
functions.doc: Cassandra 5 masking function: keeps the first `begin` and last `end` characters and replaces the rest with the padding character (default `*`). null keeps the default.

functions.name: mask_outer

functions.name: mask_hash
functions.doc: Cassandra 5 masking function: a hash of the value as a blob (SHA-256 unless another algorithm is named).

functions.name: similarity_cosine
functions.doc: Cassandra 5 vector search: cosine similarity of two float vectors of the same dimension, between 0 and 1 (1 = most similar).

functions.name: similarity_euclidean
functions.doc: Cassandra 5 vector search: similarity derived from the Euclidean distance of two float vectors of the same dimension, between 0 and 1 (1 = most similar).

functions.name: similarity_dot_product
functions.doc: Cassandra 5 vector search: dot-product similarity (vectors should be normalized) of two float vectors of the same dimension, between 0 and 1 (1 = most similar).

operators.doc: Equality. In WHERE: on partition key columns (all of them), clustering columns (prefix) or indexed columns.
Partition key or clustering column in a list of values (`id IN (1, 2, 3)`); a multi-partition IN is executed by the coordinator.
Collection column (list, set, map values) contains the value; needs an index on the collection (or ALLOW FILTERING).
Map column has the key; needs an index on the map keys (or ALLOW FILTERING).
Counter increment (`views = views + 1`), list append / prepend, set union, map merge in UPDATE … SET; number addition and (Cassandra 5) string concatenation in selectors.
Counter decrement, removal of list elements / set elements / map keys in UPDATE … SET; subtraction in selectors.
Not equal: only in lightweight-transaction conditions (IF col != value) and with SAI indexes (Cassandra 5).
Pattern match (`%` wildcards) on a column with a SASI or SAI index that supports it.
Cassandra 5 vector search: `ORDER BY embedding ANN OF [0.1, 0.2, …] LIMIT n` returns the approximate nearest neighbours (needs an SAI index on the vector column).
